items.headline: Baker throws 3 TD passes to lead Louisiana Tech over South Alabama 35-20
items.description: — Blake Baker threw three touchdown passes and Louisiana Tech shut out South Alabama in the second half for a 35-20 victory on Saturday.

items.headline: Judah Price's late TD helps Marshall edge South Alabama 20-13
items.description: — Judah Price scored on a 5-yard run with 1:49 remaining in the fourth quarter as Marshall answered a late South Alabama touchdown and held on for a 20-13 win Tuesday night.
